ownership.oneQaAgent: QA-specific workflow policy, stage contracts, and transition rules
ownership.paperclip: PROPOSED owner of task/execution state, approvals, and audit; integration is not verified
ownership.hermes: Agent execution, tools, skills, and session runtime at the integration boundary

stages.name: Scope
stages.purpose: Record the requested QA scope without inferring release scope.

stages.name: Sources / Requirements
stages.purpose: Register authoritative sources and separate confirmed requirements from unresolved items.
blockedWhen: authoritative source evidence is missing for a claimed requirement

stages.name: QA Overview
stages.purpose: Summarize confirmed scope, requirements, risks, and Need clarification items with traceability.
blockedWhen: a product expectation is asserted without source evidence

stages.name: Human Gate #1
stages.purpose: Obtain human approval before Test Design / Testcases.
blockedWhen: approval is generated only by an agent
infrastructure READY is treated as approval

stages.name: Test Design / Testcases
stages.purpose: Create source-traceable testcases or exploratory charters.

stages.name: Manual Preflight
stages.purpose: Record readiness for the approved manual QA scope.
blockedWhen: testcases or exploratory charters are missing

stages.name: Manual Execution
stages.purpose: Execute approved testcases or exploratory charters and record actual observations.

stages.name: Evidence + TC Result
stages.purpose: Attach traceable actual-execution evidence and testcase results.
blockedWhen: evidence is not traceable to an actual execution

stages.name: Triage
stages.purpose: Classify observed issues without inventing expected behavior.

stages.name: Human Gate #2 / Automation Candidate
stages.purpose: Obtain human approval of an automation candidate before automation implementation.

stages.name: Command Code / Playwright
stages.purpose: Implement approved automation in the persistent automation workspace.

stages.name: Automation Review
stages.purpose: Review automation implementation and its traceability before execution.

stages.name: Playwright Run
stages.purpose: Run reviewed automation and record execution identity.

stages.name: Automation Evidence
stages.purpose: Capture evidence generated by the actual automation run.
blockedWhen: evidence is not traceable to the Playwright run

stages.name: Automation Triage
stages.purpose: Classify automation outcomes as product bug, script issue, environment issue, flaky test, or requirement ambiguity.
blockedWhen: a failed automation test is treated automatically as a product bug

stages.name: Human Gate #3
stages.purpose: Obtain human approval before Final Report and Done.
blockedWhen: approval is generated only by an agent

stages.name: Final Report
stages.purpose: Produce the final QA report from traceable execution and triage records.

stages.name: Done
stages.purpose: Mark the workflow complete only after the approved final report exists.

transitions.condition: previous stage outputs exist and Human Gate #3 approval is APPROVED
Human Gate #1 Reject decision returns to QA Overview for revision
Human Gate #2 Reject decision returns to Triage for revision
Human Gate #3 Reject decision returns to Automation Triage for revision

evidenceAndTraceability.requirements: Every confirmed requirement must cite its source. Exploratory hypotheses must be separately labeled.
evidenceAndTraceability.manualEvidence: Evidence must be traceable to an actual manual execution record.
evidenceAndTraceability.automationEvidence: Evidence must be traceable to an actual Playwright run record.
evidenceAndTraceability.automationFailure: A failed automation test is not automatically a product bug.

paperclip.todo: Verify Paperclip task, approval, audit, and resume semantics before implementing an adapter.

hermes.boundary: Hermes must not become the source of truth for QA stage, human approval, or completion state.
hermes.todo: Verify Hermes integration interface and session-to-task correlation before implementing an adapter.

doneConditions: all required evidence and triage records are traceable
